**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION APPROVAL**

**Date:** June 9, 2025  
**Service:** Laparoscopic Sleeve Gastrectomy (CPT 43775)  
**Decision:** APPROVED

---

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement (≥35 kg/m²):** Met. Current BMI is 37.5 kg/m² based on weight and height measured today (doc-002).

**Obesity-Related Comorbidity:** Met. Patient has documented essential hypertension with recent systolic blood pressure of 129 mm Hg (obs-012, doc-003). Patient also has dyslipidemia managed with atorvastatin 20 mg daily, initiated February 29, 2024 (med-009). Both conditions are obesity-related comorbidities per policy.

**Prior Weight Management Trial:** Met. Medical record documents completion of a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial. Net weight loss was 2 kg, which was regained after medication discontinuation, documented as unsuccessful (doc-004).

**Covered Procedure:** Met. Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (CPT 43775) is a covered procedure type.

---

This authorization is valid for 30 days from the date of this letter. Please contact our office if you have questions.
